value.answer: I'd say overrated for most people. The powder is well made, tested, and tastes decent to most folks, so it's not junk. But several of the ingredients are dosed below what studies use, it's one of the pricier all-in-ones out there (around $89 a month on subscription by one listing), and I couldn't find independent clinical evidence that it does much beyond a basic multivitamin. The good reviews are mostly personal experiences, so if you like the convenience and can afford it, fine, but I wouldn't pay that for the science.
